title: Phi-Psi-Epsilon (Φπε) Unpack Codec
description: Candidate codec for the Φπε string. One skeleton, many charts. This file is a codec, not a ledger object; it does not certify any speaker string as a law. Locks exactly one operator skeleton (ADR-0008 homonym discipline); every glyph has exactly one binding; target 0 unbound homonyms. Wire values are integers or exact ratios; floating point structurally forbidden (ADR-0021). Not medical, legal, or financial advice.

number.description: Integer or exact ratio as string 'p/q'. Float forbidden (ADR-0021).

doorMode.description: Two-door remainder. Minus: habituation / decay / drawdown / relaxation. Plus: rumination / accumulation / surplus / runaway.

kernel.description: The locked skeleton inline, kernel-scope fields only. additionalProperties=false makes a third door or a new constant structurally unrepresentable.

gamma.description: Γ: spectral ordinate of the outer map.

lambda.description: Λ: computational weight kind, the step-weighted prior λ_p = κ p^-σ ||A_p||^-1 family. Contractive: sup_p λ_p(...) = c < 1.

n.description: n: discrete step / index / period / generation.

t.description: T: integration window / clock / budget / torsion horizon.

bindings.description: Chart-local semantics. Binds exactly {n, Θ, P, T, sign} - nothing else may be rebound by a chart.

meta.description: Attribution and chart identity. Never participates in kernel hashing.

cid.description: Content ID of the unpack utterance. Bound to the speaker, not to the kernel.

speaker.description: Discord snowflake or speaker handle. A snowflake is account-create time, not a geometric address. May never be minted into kernel bytes or geometry. If absent, attribution is anonymous.

chartFile.description: Chart overlay file. Binds exactly {n, thetaPrev, p, t, doorMode} to one chart's semantics. Carries the pinned kernelHash; never carries kernel values (a chart changing a kernel hash is invalid by const).

identity.planeBinding: The kernel is computational L0 (LawfulRecursionVersion 1.0), not civic law. Any hosted unpack of this codec is operator-LLC + commercial license (civic L0-5) or it does not ship.

homonymLocks.left: kernel.lambda - computational weight family λ_p; contractive c < 1.
homonymLocks.right: M = 2R + 1 - civic multiplicity scale (economics chart binding, chart-scope only).
homonymLocks.rule: Distinct binding identities. M may never appear as kernel.lambda; Λ may never appear as the pairing multiplicity. A chart rebinding is a chart file change, never a kernel change.
L0 is computational; it is not a civic rule. Codec enforces the contraction invariant on the plane it operates on; it does not legislate association bylaws.

charts.contract: A chart file binds only {n, thetaPrev, p, t, doorMode}. No chart may add kernel fields, constants, or doors. Cross-chart kernel hash must be identical: bindings and meta are excluded from the hash input by construction.

canonicalization.parse: input is parsed JSON; presentation whitespace and file key order are ignored.
canonicalization.sortKeys: object keys sorted by UTF-8 byte order, recursively, before serialization.
canonicalization.serialize: dump with ensure_ascii=false, separators (',', ':'), no trailing newline.
canonicalization.numericGuard: floating point is structurally forbidden (ADR-0021); all numbers are integers or exact ratio strings, so serialization is lossless and interpreter-stable.
canonicalization.encodeAndDigest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes of the canonical text; lowercase hex, no prefix.

kernelHash.input: the unpack document reduced to keys {version, dialect, kernel}, each recursively canonicalized.

codecHash.input: the codec file with the x-codec.hash object removed entirely, then canonicalized.

scheme.rule: kernelBytes exclude <@...>. Attribution rides in meta only.

p.semantic: how fast prior experience is discounted

doorMode.semantic: minus = habituation / decay; plus = rumination / accumulation

openQuestions: Which object is Λ when charts collide - civic M, computational λ_p, or unbound - resolver: the codec binds Λ to λ_p; M is a chart-scope binding; collision resolution belongs to the domain pack owner, not the speaker.
Who owns the chart file when bindings collide - owner: the domain pack owner named in the lever; kernel values are steward-owned.
Which legal person receives a wire attached to a Φπε unpack - default: no wire until the binder names a door, two legal persons, and one firewall paper (PMCP four gates for any managed-service path).
